images.title: A cube difference beats a square difference
images.purpose: Before and after comparison on small numbers: 4³ − 3³ = 37 against 4² − 3² = 7, drawn as two bars to scale.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Two horizontal bars stacked vertically, left aligned, with a label at the right end of each.
images.exact_structure: Exactly 2 horizontal bars stacked vertically, left aligned, drawn to scale. Top bar: long, filled teal (#0072B2), labelled 4³ − 3³ = 37 at its right end. Bottom bar: about one fifth of the top bar's length, filled amber (#E69F00), labelled 4² − 3² = 7 at its right end. Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: For the same two numbers, the difference of their cubes is far bigger than the difference of their squares.
